output.answer: Grainger's latest reported annual revenue was $17.942 billion for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. As of November 11, 2026, its FY2026 results were not yet complete; the company had updated its FY2026 net-sales guidance to $19.8–$20.0 billion.
caveats: The $17.942 billion figure is the latest completed annual result; FY2026 actual annual revenue was not available as of November 11, 2026, so $19.8–$20.0 billion is guidance rather than reported revenue.

passages.quote: Net sales of $17,942 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased $774 million, which represents a 5% increase on a reported and daily, organic constant currency basis compared to the same period in 2024.
